meta.parties: Jamis v. Suppa Umma Et Al

rules.statement: In the absence of fraud or an express warranty of title, a vendor's only primary obligations are to give the purchaser 'vacant possession' and to warrant and defend the title after the purchaser is judicially evicted.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the absence of fraud on the part of the vendor, and of an express warranty of title, he is only entitled to get vacant possession."
